outcome: Presence and characteristics of premonitory symptoms in children with migraine
cohort: 100 children and adolescents diagnosed with migraine at a Specialist Headache Service
finding: Premonitory symptoms are common in children with migraine, even in those as young as 18 months, and the clinical presentation is similar to that observed in adults.
followup_time: 18 months to 15 years at the time of headache onset
